editorial:
You are thrown into a ticking-clock thriller where every minute counts. Dr. Jack Gramm is a famous forensic psychiatrist whose testimony helped put serial killer Jon Forster behind bars. On the eve of Forster's execution, one of Gramm's students is murdered in a copycat style, and Gramm gets a chilling phone call saying he has under ninety minutes to live. The setup pulls you in fast, and you spend the whole movie racing alongside him as he tries to figure out who wants him dead before time runs out.

Al Pacino carries the film with his usual intense energy, even when the plot gets a little messy. The pacing stays brisk, the mystery keeps you guessing, and there are enough twists to keep you engaged. That said, some moments feel over-the-top, and the story can be hard to follow if you are not paying close attention. Still, if you enjoy fast thrillers with a ticking clock, this one is a fun ride. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you learn that Gramm's assistant and former lover, Shelly, is behind the threats and the copycat murder. She worked with Forster's followers to frame Gramm and make him suffer. Gramm confronts her, and she is stopped before she can kill him. Forster is executed as planned, and Gramm survives with just minutes to spare, clearing his name and ending the nightmare.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves ticking-clock thrillers and Al Pacino.
